insurer: TATA AIG General Insurance Company Limited
sum_insured_options: Not specified in wording (tables reference up to ₹3 Crore)

room_rent.note: Policy wording does not mention a room rent cap or eligibility tier; shared accommodation daily cash benefit exists as a separate incentive (B18)

icu.note: No ICU sub-limit mentioned in the policy wording

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording

sub_limits.note: Maternity capped (₹50k–₹1L), ambulance per-hospitalisation limits, hearing aid ₹10k/3yr, bariatric covered with conditions; no disease-wise sub-limits on main hospitalisation

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 months of continuous coverage (Code-Excl01)

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specified disease/procedure list (cataract, hernia, joint replacement, etc.) has 24-month waiting period (Code-Excl02)

maternity.note: Inbuilt benefit B21; limit ₹50k (up to ₹50L SI) or ₹1L (₹75L+ SI); girl child gets 20% extra; excludes pre/post-natal care and voluntary termination

cumulative_bonus.note: Option 1: 50% of SI added per claim-free year, max 100%; reduced by 50% of SI after a claim. Option 2: discount on renewal premium (alternative selection)

restoration.note: Restored SI usable for unrelated illness anytime, or related illness after 45 days from discharge; not available for first claim of the year; not applicable for B13/B31

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission (B2)

post_hosp.note: 90 days for SI up to ₹50L; 200 days for SI ₹75L–₹3Cr; plus up to 15 home physiotherapy sessions for ₹75L+ SI

day_care.note: B4 covers all day-care treatments requiring less than 24 hrs due to technological advancement

domiciliary.note: B6 covers domiciliary hospitalisation if treatment exceeds 3 days and patient cannot be moved or no hospital room available

ayush.note: B8 covers AYUSH inpatient and day-care treatment; assessed per AYUSH insurance guidelines/benchmark rates

organ_donor.note: B5 covers medical and surgical expenses of organ donor for harvesting, when insured is the recipient

ambulance.note: Tiered by SI: ₹5k (up to ₹50L), ₹7.5k (₹75L), ₹10k (₹1Cr), ₹20k (₹2Cr), ₹30k (₹3Cr) per hospitalisation (B9); air ambulance up to ₹5L or up to SI at network (B28)

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatment methods listed (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell for haematological conditions, etc.) covered under B1/B4

consumables.note: B12 covers specified consumables used during hospitalisation; personal comfort items and external durable devices excluded

global_cover.note: B13 covers planned hospitalisation outside India (diagnosis must be in India); not available for NRIs/OCIs or those who opt out; reimbursement basis

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no claim contestable except on grounds of fraud (Section 4, Clause 12)

grace_period.note: 30 days for annual/half-yearly/quarterly/single premium; 15 days for monthly instalment mode

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document

portability.note: IRDAI-compliant portability with continuity of waiting periods and NCB

notable_exclusions.display: Alcoholic pancreatitis, external congenital anomalies, growth hormone therapy, sleep apnoea, STDs, intra-articular injections admission, stem cell (non-haematological)

optional_riders.display: No optional riders listed; plan includes inbuilt global cover, consumables, bariatric, maternity, OPD, dental OPD, home care (₹75L+ SI), wellness program
